This file combines the two-period NDVI data. It had to be downloaded in two parts because of file size.

```{r}
library("dplyr")
library("lubridate")
library(readxl)
```

# NDVI 

```{r}
load("C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/baseNDVI2020_full.RData")

load("C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/baseNDVI2023_full.RData")
```

```{r}
baseNDVI2020_full
```
```{r}
baseNDVI_pre <- rbind(baseNDVI2020_full, baseNDVI2023_full)
```

```{r}
baseNDVI_sites <- baseNDVI_pre |> 
  select(site, value, calendar_date)
```

```{r}
baseNDVI_sites
```
```{r}
# Change canton names to canton codes
codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/dengue_limpio.xlsx")

codes <- codes |> 
  select(ID, "PROVINCIA Y CANTON") |> 
  filter(ID >= 101)

colnames(codes) = c("ID", "site1")
```

```{r}
codes[11, "site1"] = "VAZQUEZ DE CORONADO"
codes[20, "site1"] = "LEON CORTES CASTRO"
codes[31, "site1"] = "ZARCERO"
codes[32, "site1"] = "SARCHI"
```


```{r}
baseNDVI_sites <- baseNDVI_sites |> 
  mutate(site2 = toupper(site)) |> 
  mutate(site1 = chartr("áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚ", "aeiounAEIOU", site2))
```

```{r}
baseNDVI <- left_join(baseNDVI_sites, codes, by = "site1")

baseNDVI <- baseNDVI |> 
  mutate(fecha = ymd(calendar_date)) |>
  mutate(ndvi = value * 0.0001) |> # NDVI value needs to be recalculated because the values used by the the satellite are different
  select(c(ndvi, fecha, ID)) 
```

```{r}
write.csv(baseNDVI, "C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/baseNDVI.csv")
```
